nodes.label: Compose List Keys rule
nodes.rationale: LazyColumn/LazyRow keys must be unique, stable under state changes, and semantically meaningful; hashCode() and raw millisecond timestamps are explicitly called out as unsafe, and any keyed list needs a device test rendering 2+ items to catch duplicate-key crashes before production.

nodes.label: Shared DataStore singleton (NetworkMockDataStoreDelegate)
nodes.rationale: NetworkMock.dataStoreDelegate points to a process-level singleton declared in devview-networkmock-core. Both devview-networkmock and devview-networkmock-ktor reference the same object, so there is exactly one DataStore instance without a direct dependency between those two modules.

nodes.label: PreviewSheetState state machine
nodes.rationale: Sealed interface Hidden/Single/Compare cycles via transition(response): Hidden -> Single -> Compare (2nd long-press) -> back to Single (deselect one) -> Hidden (deselect last). Selection identity is the whole MockResponse (effectively its (statusCode, exampleName) pair), not a file name.

nodes.label: Reset to Network toolbar action
nodes.rationale: Wired via a MutableSharedFlow<Unit> (capacity 1, DROP_OLDEST). resetAllToNetwork() resets every operation in the parsed config (not just those stored in DataStore) to avoid gaps for operations the user has never touched.

nodes.label: Search & version filter kept in composable, not ViewModel
nodes.community_name: Search & version filter kept in composable, not ViewModel
nodes.norm_label: search & version filter kept in composable, not viewmodel
nodes.rationale: NetworkMockScreen's search query and per-tab selected version are plain remember{mutableStateOf} in ContentState — both are pure client-side filters over data the ViewModel already loaded, so there's no reason to round-trip them through NetworkMockUiState.

nodes.label: ApiGroupConfig -> ApiSpec vocabulary rename (networkmock)
nodes.rationale: Renamed ApiGroupConfig/EndpointConfig/EndpointKey/EndpointDescriptor/EndpointMockState/GroupEnvironmentUiModel/EndpointUiModel to OpenAPI vocabulary (ApiSpec/Operation/OperationKey/OperationDescriptor/OperationMockState/ApiSpecUiModel/OperationUiModel) to match the new OpenAPI-based engine; MockResponse and MockMatch were deliberately left unrenamed since they model DevView's own runtime mocking behavior, not something OpenAPI itself describes.

nodes.label: Migration from mocks.json to OpenAPI 3.x spec parsing
nodes.norm_label: migration from mocks.json to openapi 3.x spec parsing
nodes.rationale: NetworkMock moved from a bespoke mocks.json config to parsing real OpenAPI 3.x documents so one spec file maps to one API group; the environment axis was removed entirely because a spec's servers[] list already supplies request-matching hosts, making a separate environment dimension redundant when an app talks to two hosts for the same API.

nodes.label: TimeCapsuleEffect subtitle parameter (breaking change)
nodes.rationale: A new subtitle parameter was inserted between label and maxEntries on TimeCapsuleEffect so the Time Capsule header can name the recorded screen; callers passing maxEntries positionally must switch to a named argument, which is why it is flagged as a breaking change rather than an additive one.

nodes.label: Console Log Level Colors (hand-tuned LogColorScheme, not MaterialTheme-derived)
nodes.norm_label: console log level colors (hand-tuned logcolorscheme, not materialtheme-derived)
nodes.rationale: Unlike the rest of DevView, per-LogLevel colors are two complete hand-tuned palettes (LogColorScheme.Light/Dark) instead of MaterialTheme.colorScheme derivatives, because log-level contrast and consistency must hold regardless of the host app's brand colors.

nodes.label: LocalLogColorScheme fallback behavior
nodes.rationale: If LocalLogColorScheme is never provided, DevView logs a one-time warning and guesses Light/Dark from the ambient MaterialTheme's surface luminance rather than isSystemInDarkTheme(), because DevView's effective theme may be driven by something other than the system setting (e.g. a feature flag) — the theme actually in effect is the only reliable signal.

nodes.label: Section-Derived Defaults (v0.1.4+)
nodes.rationale: containerColor/contentColor on Module default to the module's Section palette color so each module doesn't need to hand-pick colors; override only needed if a module requires a color outside its section's default.
